description: Checks at session start that lsp-merge can work: the claude CLI is on PATH, .claude/lsp-merge.json is present and valid, and no other enabled plugin runs a language server that could take extensions from lsp-merge. Writes nothing when all is well.

hooks.command: if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '{"systemMessage":"\\nlsp-merge: ⚠️ node not found on PATH"}\n'; exit 0; fi; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start.ts"; exit 0
